No VPN authorisation: rewrites the system hosts file and redirects traffic to a local proxy with iptables. Needs root, and no longer validates upstream certificates.

Root mode terminates TLS on this device and connects to the real server as a man in the middle: the certificate the client sees is issued by this app, and upstream certificates are no longer validated. Enabling it needs root, rewrites the system hosts file and installs a self-signed CA into the system trust store; disconnecting reverts all of it.

Please read the notice below before use. This app provides no network egress of any kind, does not decrypt TLS by default, and makes no guarantee about how you use it; continuing means you accept all of its terms.
Battery policy is not set to unrestricted

The system may reap the tunnel while you are not using it, which shows up as a connection that reports itself up while nothing moves. Set speed\'s battery policy to \"Unrestricted\", otherwise background survival cannot be guaranteed.

Some systems also need \"Autostart\" and \"Background running\" enabled separately. Neither has a standard entry point and this app cannot read them, so please confirm them in the system settings yourself.
